title: Taiwan foreign minister arrives in Eswatini after president's trip blocked
description: Taiwan Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung arrived in Eswatini saying Taipei would not be held back by "authoritarian forces", ​after the government accused China of pressuring three African states to ‌block overflight permission for President Lai Ching-te.

title: Taiwan's Diplomatic Defiance: Navigating Geopolitical Skies
description: Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung visited Eswatini amidst tensions with China, who Taiwan accused of blocking airspace access via three African nations. This disruption impeded a planned presidential visit. Lin emphasized Taiwan's determination to maintain global ties despite external pressures, amid international criticism of China's actions.

title: Sihasak asks China to mediate Iran talks to protect Thai fuel
description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has asked China to assist in talks with Iran to secure energy transport routes through the Strait of Hormuz.

description: On April 17, the Japanese destroyer JS Ikazuchi transited the Taiwan Strait, the fourth such transit by a Japanese warship since September 2024, and the first since Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae took office.

title: Taiwan's MAC opposes China's bullying diplomacy after president's trip cancellation
